## [8.3.0](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/compare/v8_2_0...v8_3_0) - 2026-08-18

### Minimum supported versions

- **PHP** 8.3+
- **MariaDB** 10.6+
- **MySQL** 5.7+

See the [tested CI matrix](https://github.com/openemr/openemr/tree/rel-830/ci) for all tested version combinations.
